notes.title: [20240912] Major Update of Uncover the Smoking Gun- Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello, this is the Undercover: The Smoking Gun team. 
We're excited to share the content additions and bug fixes that come with this update!

Major Updates

- TTS - English (pilot application)
- Support for 3 additional languages - Brazilian Portuguese, Polish, Italian
- Soundtrack DLC

Added contents

 The winning entries of the fan art contest have been added as framed artwork in the detective's room and as figurines on Q-bot's desk.
 When interacting with robots in English, they now respond with voice. However, their response time will be slower than usual. If you'd like to turn off the feature, please click the speaker button below the robot's name until muted. 
 You can have a chat with Q-bot about the case when you've finished solving it.
 Three languages (Brazilian Portuguese, Polish, and Italian) have been added.
 When interrogating the surgeon robot or the counselor robot, a blinking effect is now shown when critical information is revealed or when system overload occurs.
 A visual cue has been added when using a key or card key on locked doors or drawers to make it more noticeable.
 After solving all cases, if you answer all the final questions correctly in the Detective’s Room, a video explaining the case will be unlocked.
 The ending in the Detective’s Room will change depending on whether Leo the cat from the Bio Lab is present.
 New sound effects like dart hits and page turning have been added.
 A more convincing explanation has been added regarding the changes in the culprit robot during the laboratory case, which you can discover through conversation.
 In the Detective’s Room, Q-Bot can now serve coffee and toast, while the Snitch Robot in the Bio Lab has started making items based on player requests.



Changes

 The method for stopping the hospital director robot is now more natural.
 Conversations with the auction robot will now flow more smoothly after discovering hidden events in G-Gallery.
 The dialogue for entering the storage area in G-Gallery has been adjusted to feel more natural.
 After examining evidence, the robot will now naturally reference the evidence when asking related questions, and this feature activates after the first conversation.
 Some evidence items that confused players have been changed.
 Some awkward photos have been updated to better fit the game's concept.
 The screen now transitions more smoothly when closing a conversation with a robot.
 Achievements related to playtime have been adjusted from 10, 30, and 50 hours → 3, 5, and 7 hours. (These times are only tracked while you are actively investigating.)
 Character names have been adjusted to match the situation appropriately.
 The key phrase that triggers hidden events in the Bio Lab case has been changed, allowing players to better visualize the detective’s situation.
 


Bug Fixes

 Fixed a bug where the robot wouldn’t attack when sitting and moving in the secret area in the hospital case.
 Fixed a bug where the floor would become see-through after dying from an attack while sitting in the secret area of the hospital case.

notes.title: From the Gadget Crimes Division: Q's Story - Project Atlas
notes.content:
Hello, detectives. This is the Gadget Crimes Division.

From the desk of Director Q of "Uncover the Smoking Gun," we have obtained a mysterious letter related to a recent series of incidents. This letter might hold the key to uncovering the truth behind the case. Let's take a look.

(Spoiler Alert)

To. R

About Project Atlas...

The 'Atlas Chip' featured in "Uncover the Smoking Gun" was developed to be implanted in the human brain to collect data. Aren't you curious why it's called Atlas? The chip's name is derived from Atlas in Greek mythology. After losing the war against Zeus, Atlas was punished for holding up the sky, symbolizing the duality of having the world yet bearing the pain of holding it up. This mirrors the notion that while AI's advanced performance can improve our lives, there are also side effects and concerns.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44819119/eceed970e099e60955a238fa99043b9a26b3b52d.png

The Atlas Chip is implanted in the human brain to collect and data-fy a person's lifetime. The first cervical vertebra (C1), also known as the atlas in medical terminology, was initially considered for the chip's implantation location. However, it was decided to implant the chip directly into the brain for better data extraction efficiency.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44819119/d3e5d4d22e2be5de3beb2782e3f1cce8514483bd.png
source: wikipedia

Have you ever imagined a deep learning chip implanted into the human brain? The chip is so advanced that the human brain might eventually rely on it and degrade... Me?  I'd prefer to use my brain as it is, even if it's a bit slower.

A brain implanted with a deep learning chip will rely on the chip's superior processing power, eventually leading to its degradation. Additionally, the frontal lobe, responsible for emotions and empathy, will be particularly affected. This represents the duality similar to the punishment of 'Atlas' mentioned earlier. The methods to mitigate side effects are as follows:

1. Use of Cerebrolu-X
2. Use of similar components like Donepezil
3. Implantation in humans with exceptional deep learning adaptability

Cerebrolu-X is very expensive and contains narcotic ingredients. While it's necessary to maintain humanity, abuse can ruin lives. Another effect is that it highly activates the brain upon administration, aiding in the extraction or implantation of large data volumes. Donepezil, a similar component, was originally a treatment for dementia but ceased production in 2030 after dementia was eradicated. As a result, only some researchers familiar with its similarity to Cerebrolu-X make and possess it.

[spoiler] There are non-pharmaceutical methods as well. A few individuals possess outstanding deep learning adaptability, allowing them to adapt and coexist with the chip without brain degradation. Dr. Lauren discovered this among early volunteer subjects and named it Test Subject X. Unfortunately, Test Subject X lost his life during the research, but researchers scanned and stored his data to use as learning data for the second-generation Atlas Chip. The second-generation chip is still in its early stages and is provided only to a few researchers at AIC for research purposes.... [/spoiler]


Detectives, we hope this letter greatly aids your investigation. Now, use your deductive skills and determination to uncover the truth behind the case.

notes.title: How to enjoy 'Uncover the Smoking Gun' to its full potential- Guide and Content
notes.content:
If you ever feel a bit dizzy during the gameplay, please try this. 

Options
- Turn off full screen and switch to windowed mode.
- Adjust the mouse sensitivity.
- If the sensitivity is too high, the quick rotation can cause motion sickness.

Settings
- Press the ESC key in the detective room or at the crime scene.
- Adjust the field of view (FOV). (Move around and find the viewing angle that suits you.)
- Turn motion blur on or off.
- Enable or disable damping and mouse damping.

---------------- 

How to become the best detective?

👷 First Steps as a Detective: What Kind of Detective Are You?
- How would you speak to a suspect as a detective? 
- Will you be kind, aggressive, or witty?
- Engaging with the suspect in a manner that matches your personality will make the interrogation more interesting.

🕵️ Start with Basic Investigative Questions
- What is your alibi?
- What were you doing at the time of the incident?
- Are there any other suspects you find suspicious?
- Prove that you are not the culprit.

🔍 Conduct Evidence-Based Interrogation
- When did you purchase this item?
- Why wasn't the vacuum cleaner moving?
- Where is the controller for the RC car?

🔧 Beware of [System Overload]
- [Configuring Response] can be reliable. However, be suspicious of [System Overload].
- The suspect might provide a different testimony if a system overload occurs.

Now you are a prepared detective. Interrogate the robot suspect and solve the case!
